subject: Packaging exception request: LaunchHub cohort — stacking promo credits with dedicated discount
messages:
From: Sophia Grant <sophia@launchhub.org>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@launchhub.org
Date: 2028-03-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: program packaging — stacking credits + dedicated discount

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick intro on the conference floor — LaunchHub is running its spring cohort (25 startups, demo day in June) and I wanted to check whether Redwood can accommodate a promo/packaging exception.

Overview:
- We typically offer each startup $2,000 in vendor credits and ask partners to match/augment.
- For Redwood, the ask is: 1) allow the $2k promotional credit to be stacked with a follow-on Dedicated discount (if a startup converts to Dedicated within 90 days), and 2) an introductory cohort bundle price for the first 3 months.

Why this matters: the cohort is early but high-velocity; converting a few high-usage teams would be meaningful for both sides. We understand this is nonstandard; happy to sign a short-term SOW or put conversion SLAs in place.

Attached: LaunchHub-Partner-Request.pdf (one-pager with cohort details).

Can you let me know the decision path and any guardrails (caps, ROI clauses, transferability limits) Redwood would want?

Best,
Sophia Grant
Partnerships, LaunchHub Accelerator
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Grant <sophia@launchhub.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T11:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: program packaging — stacking credits + dedicated discount

Hi Sophia — thanks for the note and the attachment. Short answer: we can consider a tailored packaging exception but will need to scope conversion triggers and a spend cap.

Can you confirm:
- Exact number of startups (you mentioned ~25) and an expected 90-day avg monthly usage per startup (tokens or $).
- Whether the $2k credit is vendor-funded by LaunchHub or a co-funded match.
- Any requirement for credits to be transferable between founders within the same company.

Internal next steps: looping in Ben (pricing lead) and Lauren (partner approvals) to surface constraints. My preference is: pilot window = 3 months of stacked credits, with a discretionary Dedicated conversion discount (20%) for startups that convert within 90 days and meet usage thresholds. We'd put a cohort-level cap (e.g., $30k in total credit exposure) and require a signed SOW.

If that sounds reasonable, Ben can draft SOW language and a short billing carve-out we can use for approval.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Growth Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Sophia Grant <sophia@launchhub.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-02T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: program packaging — stacking credits + dedicated discount

Hi all — happy to run numbers. Based on cohort size = 25 and conservative usage, here's a proposed commercial guardrail set for DH-2028-044: 

- Promo stacking: allow LaunchHub $2,000 credit to be stacked on top of Redwood trial credits for the first 3 months. Credit terms: non-transferable, expire at 90 days if unused.
- Conversion discount: 20% off Redwood Dedicated list price for 6 months if a startup converts within 90 days and sustains >= $500/mo usage for at least one month.
- Cohort cap: Redwood credit liability capped at $35,000 total (accumulated across cohort).
- Marketplace/marketing clause: Redwood logo + co-marketing ok; Redwood reserves right to opt out of case studies.
- Accounting: usage applies to Partner SOW and will be tracked under deal id DH-2028-044. LaunchHub will provide a single point of contact and roster for verification.

Attached: SOW-draft-LaunchHub.docx (pricing section draft).

If LaunchHub can confirm roster and expected usage ranges (low/median/high), we can finalize the cap and sign SOW.

—Ben
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophia Grant <sophia@launchhub.org>
Date: 2028-03-05T10:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: program packaging — stacking credits + dedicated discount

Hannah/Ben — I reviewed Ben's proposal and we can approve the packaging exception subject to two conditions:

1) Limit cohort enrollment to 25 startups (confirmed).
2) Define two success triggers in the SOW that extend the discount window: (a) if >= 4 startups convert to Dedicated within 90 days, extend the 20% discount for an additional 3 months; (b) if average conversion ARR projection across converters exceeds $X (finance will fill in), marketing and sales get a case study option.

Also require: LaunchHub agrees to a single HubSpot record and provides monthly usage reports for the cohort. Legal wants the credit to be explicitly non-transferable and non-refundable. Once those items are in SOW we can route for signatures.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Sophia Grant <sophia@launchhub.org>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-07T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: program packaging — stacking credits + dedicated discount

Thanks Hannah/Ben/Lauren — that framework works for LaunchHub. We confirm:
- Cohort = 25 startups; LaunchHub will be vendor-funding the $2k credits (we'll provide a roster).
- Expected usage: median ~$350/month, high cases up to $1,200/month; we'll send a short usage estimate table by EOD Monday.
- Non-transferable credits is fine.

Next steps: please send a SOW + DocuSign link and we'll execute. We'd also like a short co-marketing blurb and permission to include Redwood as "LaunchHub official infra partner" in cohort materials.

Attached: partner_agreement_v1.pdf (LaunchHub draft). HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/contacts/LAUNCHHUB-2291

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to running the pilot.

Best,
Sophia
Partnerships, LaunchHub Accelerator
